info.name: Connect two numbers or connect a number to a call flow

items.docs: Places an outbound call. In the "connect two numbers" mode, Exotel first calls `From`, and when answered connects to `To`. In the "connect to a flow" mode, provide `Url` pointing to an Exotel call flow (App/applet, e.g. `http://my.exotel.com/{sid}/exoml/start_voice/{flow_id}`) instead of `To`. Confirmed endpoint; body schema modeled from documented form parameters.
